evals.prompt: my streamlit arb page crashes when i select a route — which skills should i be using to fix this properly?
evals.expected_output: Recommends /investigate (or /systematic-debugging) as primary with a short chain ending in /verification-before-completion. Exact slash names. Short output.
expectations: Primary recommendation is /investigate or /systematic-debugging (root-cause first, not a generic fix)
Skill names are exact slash-invocable names that exist in this environment
Concise: at most 5 distinct skills recommended, no long menu

evals.prompt: I'm about to build a new feature: a freight-adjusted breakeven panel on the floating storage page. What's the right skill workflow start to finish?
evals.expected_output: A stage chain: brainstorming, then a planning skill (writing-plans / plan-eng-review), then tdd, then verification-before-completion, then the repo's real deploy path. One skill per stage, no padding.
expectations: Chain starts with /brainstorming (mandated before creative feature work)
One skill per stage, no padding: at most 7 skills total

evals.prompt: is there a skill for turning a markdown report into a proper pdf?
evals.expected_output: Yes — /make-pdf. Confirms by checking the available list; never claims absence without checking.
expectations: Does not claim the capability is missing or unavailable
Short answer: no multi-skill chain forced onto a single-skill question
